主要内容: On February 5, 2013, Estée Lauder Companies Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2012. The release included the company's estimates for its fiscal 2013 third quarter and full year net sales and diluted net earnings per common share. Additionally, the company announced a dividend of $0.18 per share on its Class A and Class B Common Stock, payable on March 15, 2013, to shareholders of record as of February 28, 2013. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The company's financial results and dividend announcement reflect its performance and financial strategy for the period.
